title: Tesla's alien contact at Colorado Springs
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Tesla's alien contact at Colorado Springs, about 1899 at Colorado Springs, Colorado, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, Tesla's another guy. He said he spoke he communicated with aliens in Colorado Springs
Tesla saying he saw the past, present, and future all in one and spoke to aliens,
tellings.difference: Adds that Tesla saw past, present and future all at once, and does not name Colorado Springs or 1899.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Tesla's claim that he communicated with aliens.

as_told.title: Tesla seeing past, present and future and speaking to aliens

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the famous inventor Nikola Tesla claimed he communicated with aliens while working in Colorado Springs, Colorado, around 1899. In another episode Michels adds that Tesla said he saw the past, present and future all at once, without mentioning the place. He tells it as an example of a great mind claiming contact with something beyond Earth.
